text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Chartered Institute of Bankers of Nigeria has urged the central bank to strengthen its supervisory and regulatory roles to prevent fraud.
- United States pursues sanctions against Nigeria
- Nigeria and Turkey strebgthen diplomatic ties

- Three distressed merchant banks; Investment Corporation of Nigeria, Continental Merchant Bank and Nigerian Merchant Bank may be recapitalised with 1.5 billion naira if the government accepts a proposal which is already before it. The other option is to sell bank assets to recapitalise them.
